beats.headline: Platinum spell books
beats.text: Carl has been putting off his boxes to have a distraction. Everyone else has already opened their platinum quest boxes, and most of what they got was spell books. Donut's holds a tome of Twinkle Toes, a cheap spell that makes Mongo, or any other minion, run really fast for as many seconds as her intelligence level. She is pretty excited about it. Katia gets a spell called Hanzo, Louis and Firas get spellbooks too, and Gwen gets a new spear.

beats.headline: Faster than the buggy
beats.text: Carl drives the chariot down the main road while Donut rides Mongo alongside. Her Twinkle Toes spell lets Mongo run faster even than the dune buggy, and she has been practicing it, trying to level it up. Mongo loves going fast and screeches with joy whenever she casts the spell. Carl stops a few times to plant claymore-like mines that only hunters will trigger.

beats.headline: Two riders, two spells
beats.text: Bautista drives the carriage, with Carl, Imani, Katia and others aboard. Donut rushes alongside to the left astride Mongo with Twinkle Toes active, Mongo decidedly more buff with the Muscle Mommy benefit. On the other side Dong rides Gonk, his own Twinkle Toes active, making the swamp yak run astonishingly fast, while Bigs whoops on the yak's head. Jamal holds up the rear on his spider legs, spurting little bursts of flame.

beats.headline: Not for special mounts
beats.text: The party leader must choose a vehicle, mechanical or biological. Donut thinks the animal is the best choice: she has the Twinkle Toes spell and a level 15 Heal Critter, though Mongo won't like another animal in the party. Pet spells don't work on special mounts, Hedy the gremlin gasps from the garage floor, and clocks the other gremlin with a mallet. Neither Twinkle Toes nor Heal Critter will work on them.
